Agent A (Phase 12 async exports): the SUPER_ADMIN plane split (a platform export has no salon, runs across salons as its request did, and is authorized by the DERIVED platform key) and the customer realm (a customer principal is not in the staff authorization state; its own account row is re-checked instead). Authorization itself is the route's guards + permissions.

Agent A (Phase 12): the pre-Phase-12 billing / revenue-residual export jobs are platform records — only a platform principal may read them through /super-admin/operations (then the job's own key decides).

BUILD_PLAN Phase 13 D (Constitution 6 §37): realm routing of the biometric device credential — the SUPER_ADMIN plane is refused Face ID (platform accounts use password + authenticator), and the branch picker is skipped for the two realms that have no branch to pick at sign-in (CUSTOMER, OWNER), exactly as password sign-in does.

Oct 12 2026 merge (AUTH, workforce audit P2 #28): branch selection fails CLOSED for a TECHNICIAN session — her branches are her employment (one user_branch_access grant per membership), an identity fact of the base role, not a capability a permission could express; owners/staff keep the documented fail-open.

Oct 12 2026 merge (AUTH, workforce audit P0 #13): a TECHNICIAN token is never a manager in the Tech App even when a per-salon override handed it technicians.edit — a technician must not decide her own skill request / resolve manager messages. Belt-and-braces on top of the permission. Oct 13 2026 (wave 4): the same identity fact opens the salon help inbox to the front desk (technicians.view) while a technician keeps reading only her own messages.

Technician Profile merge (WF, Oct 12 2026): /media/* private-object read decision. SUPER_ADMIN = the platform plane split; the staff-role set (OWNER/MANAGER/FRONT_DESK/RECEPTION) applies ONLY together with a DB-confirmed active membership of the owning profile at the session's tenant — the media route resolves a bare session (cookie/bearer), not a permission set. Move to a resolved permission when /media carries the authorization state.

Technician Profile merge (WF, Oct 12 2026): branch-transfer data move — only a TECHNICIAN login has the technician roster / membership / branch-grant rows to move (the role -> template mapping, not an authorization decision; the route itself is SuperAdminGuard + permission).
